page.overview:
Who is Lang Rangler?

Lang Rangler is an inmate of Green Dolphin Street Prison sent by Enrico Pucci to assassinate Jolyne Cujoh and Weather Report on their way to the prison courtyard in order to stop them from delivering Jotaro Kujo's Stand DISC to the Speedwagon Foundation. He is a Stand User and wields the gravity-altering Stand, Jumpin' Jack Flash.

Lang is a man of average to above-average height and medium build.

Very little can be seen of his face, as he is clad in an assortment of makeshift gear designed to insulate him from the effects of his Stand. This includes a flat-topped hat covering his face to below his eyes with a serrated bottom edge, and goggles. As such, nothing of his hair or even eyes can be distinguished, leaving his actual face enigmatic.

Beside Lang's legs are red coloured sneakers with white laces tied at his legs, He also kept a bottle in the right red sneaker.
